name: jint
readme_excerpt: Jint Jint is a modern ECMAScript interpreter for .NET. It runs JavaScript directly in your process without native dependencies, bytecode generation, or a separate runtime. Jint targets .NET Framework 4.7.2, .NET Standard 2.0/2.1, .NET 8, and .NET 10. Start with the documentation or install the core package: Quick start The examples below assume using Jint;.
